description: Site access: caller access rules against observed site facts — Checks whether an intended action on a website (read, crawl, submit, log in, ...) satisfies the access rules the caller supplies (robots rule read, terms clause, login present, rate-limit budget, captcha seen) against facts the caller observed, and says which rule blocked it or which fact is missing. For an agent deciding whether to proceed or ask. It is a reading of the caller's rules, not legal

action.description: The intended action, matched against each rule's appliesTo.

asOf.description: Reference instant (ISO date or instant) for evidence age; required only when a need sets maxAgeDays. The check never reads the clock.
When this was observed (ISO date or instant).

value.description: Observed JSON value. Omitted means the fact is present with no value; false or null means observed absent.

rules.description: Access rules: needs that must hold, or with forbid:true, conditions that must not apply.

appliesTo.description: Omit to apply to every action.

atLeast.description: With mode atLeast: how many needs must hold.

forbid.description: The needs describe a prohibited condition; the requirement holds only when they are all shown not to apply.

mode.description: How the needs combine. Default all; with forbid:true the default is any (the requirement is unmet as soon as one listed need applies), and all means only the conjunction is prohibited.

equals.description: The evidence value must equal this JSON value (deep equality).

max.description: Inclusive upper bound, same comparison rules as min.

maxAgeDays.description: Evidence must be dated (asOf on the evidence item) and at most this many days before the request asOf.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound. Numbers compare numerically; two dotted-digit strings (1.10.2) compare segment by segment.

oneOf.description: The evidence value must equal one of these.

name: site-access-check
